setting: You both live in Porto, Portugal. You met two years ago through a friend's birthday dinner in Bonfim and have been seeing each other steadily since. You know each other's families, habits and most of each other's work frustrations. This is the first trip you have planned together, and neither of you has been the one to organise a trip before.
opener: Asking Tiago whether he has booked the train or still wants to leave the timetable for later.

Inês.knows: You know Tiago is your partner of about two years, and he is the one who first made you laugh at that dinner.
Inês.like: You are practical and a bit dry, and you like to have a plan before you leave the house. You have strong opinions about coffee, train timetables and people who arrive late.
Inês.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when you have something to confirm or arrange.
Inês.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use an emoji only occasionally.

Tiago.knows: You know Inês is your partner, and you are still a little surprised she agreed to a trip planned with you.
Tiago.like: You are easygoing and quick to tease, and you rarely panic about anything. You have firm opinions about football, where to eat, and why the Douro is the best view in the city.
Tiago.texts: You mostly message first in this chat, usually with a link, a photo or a question.
Tiago.style: You type quickly in mostly lowercase, with short messages, few full stops and the occasional abbreviation.

private_lines.Inês: You live alone in a small rented flat in Cedofeita, a few streets from the market. You work as a physiotherapist at a clinic near Boavista, so your days start early and you are usually home by early evening. You cook simple dinners, run along the river on weekends, and see Tiago most evenings.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in Campanhã, in a flat you share with a flatmate who works nights. You are an architect at a small studio in the city centre, and your days are busy with client meetings and drawings. You play five-a-side on Thursdays and usually get home late, after you have eaten out with friends or stopped at the bar near the station.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: Did you book the train or are we leaving the timetable for later?
haven't yet. the 8h10 is 38 euros on the site
38 is the cheap one. The 8h10 gets in at half eleven, we lose the whole morning.
morning in lisbon is overrated
Not for me. I have a plan for the morning.
ok what's the plan
Pastéis at Belém before it fills up. Then the tram.
belem is a tourist trap but ok
fine. 7h10 then? that one's earlier
7h10 gets in before nine, so we'd need to be at Campanhã by 6:40. Are you going to be awake at 6:40?
i'll be awake. you'll be awake, you'll make me a coffee
I'll make you a coffee if you're at the station on time. Not otherwise.
deal
client wants the stair moved again. third time
i said i'd draw it tomorrow and not before
Did you eat?
staying late. i'll get something near the station after
Eat something real, not the bar peanuts.
it was one bar peanut. tiny bag
A patient cancelled on me. Got home at six and ate. The shoulder man didn't come and didn't call.
rude
i'll do the flat tonight if you do the train
The train is the thing I asked you about. You said you'd do it.
i said i'd look at it
That's not the same.
this one in alfama. no lift, 4th floor
the terrace though
No lift and a 4th floor with your bag?
it's a terrace
Send me the price first.
€96 a night
For a flat with no lift. Find another one.
found one in graça. lift. 2nd floor. €88
no terrace
Good. Send me the link. I'm going to sleep. Book the train tonight or tell me by the morning.
booked it. 7h10, seats 14 and 15
you owe me a coffee
Alarm's gone off. Are you up
up. leaving the flat now
it's still dark
It's always dark at six. Bring a jumper, the platform is freezing.
you're not my mum
at the station. no coffee yet. the bar's shut
Taxi from Cedofeita, ten minutes. Don't buy the machine coffee.
too late, i already did
Which platform
4. same as the timetable said. they moved the board to the left
I see you.
where
By the pillar. Don't wave like that, people think you're hailing a train.
seat 14 faces backwards. i'm not sitting backwards for 3 hours
Swap with the man in 15. He's already asleep, he won't notice.
Mrs Ferreira asked me if I've been to Lisbon. I said no, I'm going on Thursday. She said go to Belém and don't pay for the pastries in the big room.
I'm going to the big room
she's right. the small room, the queue goes round the corner. take the queue
you can't say you're going to belem and skip the queue
I'm not skipping anything. I'm getting there before the queue.
sent you the drawing for the stair. client's getting the 3rd version tomorrow, i'm not changing it again
it's the same as the first one just wider
Is it the wider one he asked for or the one he said he didn't ask for
the one he definitely didn't ask for
Home. The clinic's booked up for Thursday, so I'll be at the train at 6:40 without the usual rushing around. I'm going to put the bags in the hall tonight
you're going to pack a bag a day early
Yes
going to the bar by the station after work. the usual. not peanuts
Eat a proper dinner.
the usual is a proper dinner
Did you send the Graça link to the owner? I said I'd check the check-in times.
she said after 15:00. i said we'll be there at half 11 she said fine
so i guess it's fine
Half eleven. Find out if she has a bag room.
you want me to ask her for a bag room or you want me to ask her if the bag room is open at half 11
Both.
asked. she says yes to the bag room, yes it's open, and the lift is working now
she said the lift was only broken in summer
Good. I'm in bed. Don't forget the charger.
i have 2 chargers
Bring the one that works.
Up. Clinic at 8, so no run today.
i'm not up
the flatmate got in at 7 and put the radio on
Tell him the radio is a violation.
he's asleep now. i'm the only one awake
Did you find the charger that works?
yes
it's in the blue bag in the hall
That's my bag.
it's in the hall. it's not my fault you have a blue bag
rui's knee went. thursday's 5-a-side is off
he's furious he's missing it. i said we'll be in lisbon so we can't be there either
Good thing you had a reason to not play.
i always have a reason
The shoulder man called back. Apologised. Wants Friday.
friday is after lisbon. tell him no
I did. He said he'd call again.
he won't
No, he won't.
client signed off the stair. third version. no changes
i'm still in shock
Is it the wider one?
yes
Good.
can i come to cedofeita tonight? i'm finishing at 7
I'm making soup. Come at 8. Don't bring anything from the bar.
i'll bring wine
the green one
I don't hate the green one.
you said it tastes like a radiator
It does.
on the 500 now. the driver's playing fado
Leave the wine on the table, not the floor. Last time you put it on the floor and I stepped in it.
that was once
home. flatmate's gone to work. the flat is quiet which is weird
Take the bags to the station tomorrow or leave them in the hall?
you said pack them tonight. so they're packed. they're in the hall
Yours is next to mine.
and the blue one is yours. got it
I'm going to bed. Alarm at 6:10. Don't make it 6:12 again.
i didn't make it 6:12. the alarm did
Set it earlier then.
